name: selftest_it_helpdesk
brief: An IT helpdesk assistant for shore staff and ship masters: account lockouts and passwords, laptop replacement, support hours and incident priorities, and vessel internet allowances. It should also help users reset their own password directly.

name: ship_spares
brief: Build a procurement assistant for our technical superintendents and chief engineers. It should look up spare parts in our catalogue (price, stock, lead time, supplier, minimum order), calculate order totals including supplier discounts and fees, tell them who has to approve an order, and estimate the dispatch date for an order placed today. It should also compare supplier terms like payment, warranty and returns, and show each supplier's on-time delivery rating.

name: hr_policy
brief: I need an assistant that answers HR policy questions for our shore staff - things like annual and sick leave, parental leave, travel bookings and expense claims, hybrid working and the code of conduct. It should also be able to tell employees how much income tax and pension is deducted from their payslip. Answers must be short and point to the policy they come from, and it must never give personal legal advice.
